items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: I know he's becoming here. We were talking about him this morning... Rochon, he's a preacher now, he's out of it too. Sax. He was a good man on the sax.

ctx.x: Chris? Yeah. Didn't you say something about brother and Guy there?

Oh, they were two brothers, yeah, quite natural. But Guy Kelly, yeah, oh yeah, they were brothers. But Guy Kelly was more musical, you know, reading man. Read more. That's how he stayed more with Papa Celestine. But Chris was just actually anywhere, any little job, three pieces, four pieces, he would get to play it. But they claim he knew a lot of music. He never played it though. I was told he read red, red, yeah, red, nice. He got out of the story. What about this fella, Rochon, you mentioned
the other day? Alexis. Is that his name, Alexis Rochon? Alexis Rochon. And what instrument did he play?
